title: Design System: React.js pour les aventuriers (demos)

shadows.name: panel-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter shadow that follows the cut corners of every panel.

shadows.name: page-wash
shadows.purpose: Ambient gold light at the top of the body background; not an elevation cue.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing: 0.2s buttons, 0.4s panels, 0.6s health width.

motion.name: cells-in
motion.value: 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0)
motion.purpose: Health cells light left to right when a card appears. All motion disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

shapes.name: cut
shapes.purpose: Diagonal corner cut on panels (top-left, bottom-right).

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cyan parallelogram outline on a slate fill; the quiet default action.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid rune-gold parallelogram; the single primary action (Soigner, submit). When disabled it retreats to the muted, slate-edged look.

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: Struck-through label with a slate outline and panel face; never merely greyed. Also the state of a disabled primary.

components.name: Hero Panel
components.description: Opaque slate panel with two cut corners, cyan-dim hairline and soft drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-card{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding:1.25rem 1.5rem 1.35rem;color:var(--text);font-family:Rajdhani,system-ui,sans-serif;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.45))}.ds-card::before,.ds-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:-1}.ds-card::before{inset:0;background:var(--cyan-dim);clip-path:polygon(0 16px,16px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 16px),calc(100% - 16px) 100%,0 100%)}.ds-card::after{inset:1px;background:var(--panel);clip-path:polygon(0 15.41px,15.41px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 15.41px),calc(100% - 15.41px) 100%,0 100%)}.ds-card h2{font:700 1.55rem/1.2 Cinzel,Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--gold);margin:0}.ds-card p{margin:0 0 .75rem;color:var(--muted)}.ds-bar{height:18px;background:rgba(90,210,230,.16);transform:skewX(-20deg);-webkit-mask-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0 calc(10% - 4px),transparent calc(10% - 4px) 10%);mask-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0 calc(10% - 4px),transparent calc(10% - 4px) 10%)}.ds-bar-fill{height:100%;width:70%;background:var(--cyan)}.ds-bar-alert .ds-bar-fill{background:var(--ember)} .ds-bar-fill{animation:ds-cells-in .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}@keyframes ds-cells-in{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}to{clip-path:inset(0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-bar-fill{animation:none}}

components.name: Field
components.description: Square dark field with a 2px cyan underline that turns gold on focus.

components.name: Title Ornament
components.description: Gold hairline with a centred diamond under the page title; decoration bound to the h1.

narrative.overview: The Taverne de React-vania is rendered as a sci-fantasy codex console: every hero is an arcane readout on an opaque slate panel, health is counted in slanted cyan cells, and runes are gold. Neo-futuristic with the fantasy cliches kept, depth comes from cut geometry and one dark drop shadow; the only warm light is a faint gold wash at the top of the page. Quiet infrastructure for a lesson: state must be legible at a glance, and every interactive element is a standard button or field.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-blue ground with a faint cyan dot grid (34px) and a soft gold wash at the top, opaque slate panels on top.
A gold hairline-and-diamond ornament under the page title.
Two diagonal cut corners (16px) on every panel; parallelogram buttons; slanted health cells.
Cyan structural; gold only for headings and the single primary action; ember only for alerts.
Cinzel for titles only; Rajdhani for everything else, tabular figures.
State is never carried by color alone.

rules.name: The Gold Is Scarce Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on headings, the title ornament that belongs to the h1, the top-of-page wash, and the one primary action per context (Soigner in a card, any submit button). Hover or focus within a card may borrow gold for its hairline. Gold decoration is limited to that one title-bound ornament and the ambient wash; never use gold for other decoration or secondary buttons. A disabled primary leaves gold entirely.

rules.name: The Ember Means Alert Rule
rules.body: Ember is used only with an accompanying text alert. It is never a brand accent.

rules.name: The Titles Only Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is for h1 and h2. Everything the learner reads or clicks is Rajdhani.

rules.name: The Shadow Follows The Cut Rule
rules.body: Panel shadow is a filter: drop-shadow, never box-shadow, so cut corners stay honest. Interaction changes the hairline color and neighbours' opacity, not elevation.

dos: Do keep gold for headings and one primary action per context.
Do pair every ember or disabled state with a text or strikethrough cue.
Do build new panels from the cut-corner polygon (16px) and new buttons from the parallelogram recipe.
Do show state through the cell count, K.O. hairline, and heading dimming.
Do use drop-shadow filter for panel shadow and respect prefers-reduced-motion (transitions and animation off).
Do retreat a disabled primary to the muted, slate-edged look; a disabled control must never read as active.
donts: Don't use rounded corners, glowing elements, or neon blur; the world is hard-cut, opaque, and dark.
Don't use the violet-and-gold parchment fantasy card or a neon dashboard look.
Don't use gold or ember as decoration beyond the title ornament and page wash, or for secondary actions.
Don't use Cinzel for body, labels or buttons.
Don't let color alone carry state.
